tag: Another Final Episode · Spring in the World of Fortune
title: A Wedding Beneath the Moonlit World Tree

ending.label: Spring in the World of Fortune

beats.t: Three years later, spring in the world of fortune began on a night when the moon waxed full twice. Silver lotuses bloomed at every tip of the World Tree.
Two new yellow umbrellas stood side by side at Yeoni's door. The original, wrapped in three layers of tape, was with Hanbi beyond the door.
During three months of wedding preparations, Yeoni listed tasks: veil embroidery, guest seats, two matching pairs of socks.
Byeongha revised his vows three times. Each draft included a promise to do it alone. Each time, Yeoni crossed it out.
Whatever happens, I'll speak first. I won't disappear alone again under the excuse of protecting you.
And I'll tell you when I'm hurting. I won't bear it alone just to reassure you.
Instead of grand prophecies, their wedding vows filled with small promises. Don't skip meals. Don't hold the umbrella alone. If memories grow hazy, start by reading the notes together.
Add coming to my show once a month. Essential cultural enrichment for a married couple.
That's a ticket subscription, not a vow.
The evening before the wedding, she watched the empty space from the chair by the door. A golden line briefly opened. Spring had reached the riverbank in reality too.
At a bus stop, Hanbi shared a yellow umbrella with a student afraid of the night. No answers offered. She simply stood there until the bus came.
Hanbi, you're better at tilting an umbrella than I am now.
Yeoni closed the door and went home. Byeongha was sorting socks in the entryway, and one pair was still mismatched.
These are yours. I put them in my drawer because you made them go missing first.
A sock trial even on the day before our wedding. That's so us.
Next morning, before leaving for the ceremony, they switched off the teahouse lights one by one. Only the little lamp above the chair by the door stayed on.
My socks match, right? Check properly today.
Pale purple on the left, pale purple on the right. Pass. You're more thorough today than when you saved the world.
It's our wedding. One black sock sneaks in and we've got an incident.
Yeoni fastened her white veil behind the lotus ornament in her hair. A tiny embroidered flower pig hung at its edge, stitched by her own hand to remember the form in which her journey began.
One song before the bride comes in. Two moons, one team in love. A brand-new rhythm over time returned!
When Moka raised the microphone, the fairies flew while tapping the rhythm with their feet. For this one day, even the saucepan and ladle waited quietly beside the stage.
By the moon's angle, there is still a little time before the ceremony, but today the moment you choose is the right time.
Kang Saebyeok, no asking for birth dates today. Start a compatibility consultation at the wedding and I'll dock your star rating.

Beneath the World Tree, there were seats for everyone they had met on the journey. For those who had lost their memories, those whose names had been stolen, and those who had not chosen forgiveness but were preparing what came next together.
Seats arranged by the Five Elements. Moka is Fire, so I kept the pot far away.
Can Moka survive without a pot?
Standing in the moonlit place, Yeoni heard the World Tree's heartbeat. The sound that had frightened them on first falling into this world was now as comforting as the clock at home.
Byeongha held out his hand. His palm was slightly damp. More nervous than when saving the world.
The golden line of the twenty-third door opened beside the guests' seats. Beyond it lay the cherry-blossom riverbank in reality.
Beyond the line, Hanbi raised the yellow umbrella wrapped in three layers of tape. First, she tilted it toward the person beside her.
Yeoni's mother stood beside Seo Hanbi. The edge of the letter in her hands trembled, but she was smiling.
Mom, I'm living well. This is my home. But that doesn't change the fact that I'm your daughter.
Beyond the door, their mother nodded. Her voice did not carry, but the shape of her words was clear. As long as you're happy.
Yeoni. You chose this moment, too. You can cry or laugh. Just don't let go of my hand.
You're the one who mustn't let go. You turned back time alone once. From now on, we write it together.
Byeongha took Yeoni's hand. It was the hand he had been unable to reach in the first spring and had had to hide in the second. Today he held it where everyone could see.
As Park Byeongha, as Neo, as Yeongnyangi, I love you. Whatever my name, I will stay beside you without hiding.
The me who was a flower pig, the me who was human, and the me of tomorrow all want to live with you. Let's not close our ending today.
The World Tree's lotuses bloomed all at once. Red threads, golden letters, and tiny fragments of the Milky Way fell over the pair.
Congratulations rap, starting now! Fate isn't a verdict—it's lyrics you two rewrite every day!
The five elements are flowing without tilting to one side. But balance isn't something finished once today. Keep adjusting it together.
That's our specialty. Arguing, talking, and taking each other's hands again.
Don't leave out using star ratings as a threat.
In the front row, a wind fairy burst into tears: Yeoni's first consultation guest. Moka beat a pot with the ladle in place of applause.
After the wedding, Yeoni and Byeongha spread out a place to sit beneath the World Tree's roots. Far away, a single cherry blossom fell beside the river in reality.
Beyond the line, Hanbi waved an envelope. The next letter, her lips slowly said.
We'll live our spring well here, too. Let's keep exchanging news.
The Twenty-third Door closed into a little star. No one knew when the next letter would come. Yeoni kept the chair by the door anyway.
Are you happy?
Yes. It isn't ordinary, but it's the spring I chose. So to me, it's ordinary enough.
Byeongha rested his forehead against Yeoni's. Between their hands, the moonlight turned a warm gold.
Let's go. Into our next spring.
[ Destiny Restored · Spring in the World of Fortune ]
